title: neoschroetera glutinosa
intro: Neoschroetera glutinosa, commonly known as the Himalayan shoja, is a plant species traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Neoschroetera glutinosa are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve coughs, and exhibit expectorant properties, making it a sought-after remedy for respiratory and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Neoschroetera glutinosa include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
